summary: Tested Admin Reset Password feature (POST /api/admin/reset-user-password) both backend and frontend. All 3 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend admin dashboard renders 15 UserCards each with a blue KeyRound reset-password button; modal opens with correct testids; weak password submission triggers backend 400 and shows error toast; cancel closes modal. Restored testmale user's password back to Test@2026 after login-with-new-password verification.

issues: Password hint text says 'Min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number, 1 special char' but backend validate_password_strength only enforces min 6 chars. Hint is misleading — either strengthen backend rule or update UI hint to match actual rule.

action_items: Fix mismatch between UI password hint text and backend password validation rule in Reset Password modal (AdminDashboard.jsx line ~1154).
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY: POST /api/admin/reset-user-password has NO admin auth/authorization check. Any unauthenticated caller can reset ANY user's password by user_id. This is a critical security risk in production even if it 'matches other admin endpoints' — recommend adding admin-token or session-based auth on all /admin/* endpoints.
The password hint UI in the modal contradicts backend validation (min 6 chars only). Backend should enforce stronger policy for admin resets.
